_comment: 見本の商品の写真(AI で作る)と、見本の商品ページの説明。scripts/sample-photos.py が読む。codes は、同じ商品の JP・US の商品コード(画像は共通、説明は市場の言語)。shots の先頭がメイン。2 枚目からは、メインの画像を手本に渡して、同じ商品として作る。実在のブランド・ロゴ・人に似せない(人は顔が写らない構図だけ)

style.product: Professional e-commerce product photograph for an apparel online store. Photorealistic, shot with a DSLR, pure white seamless background, soft even studio lighting, subtle natural shadow under the item, sharp focus, true-to-life fabric texture and stitching, centered, 3:4 portrait framing. No logo, no brand name, no text, no watermark, no person, no hands.
style.detail: Professional e-commerce macro detail photograph. Photorealistic, shallow depth of field, soft diffused studio light, neutral background, true-to-life material texture, 3:4 portrait framing. No logo, no brand name, no text, no watermark, no person, no hands.
style.worn: Professional e-commerce lookbook photograph. Photorealistic, light warm-grey studio background, soft natural light, a model wearing the item, framed from the neck down so no part of the face (no eyes, nose, mouth or chin) is visible, relaxed natural pose, 3:4 portrait framing. The model must not resemble any real person. No logo, no brand name, no text, no watermark.
style.scene: Professional lifestyle photograph for an online store. Photorealistic, natural daylight, calm and tidy setting, the item is the clear subject, 3:4 portrait framing. No people's faces, no logo, no brand name, no text, no watermark.
style.reference: The attached image is the main product photo. Show exactly the same product (same color, material, shape and details) as in the attached image.
style.hero: Professional seasonal campaign key visual for an apparel online store's email and banners. Photorealistic editorial fashion photograph, natural light, calm and refined mood, 4:3 landscape framing with the main subject near the center and generous margins on every side (the image is cropped to different shapes later). People, if any, are shown from behind, from the side with the face turned away, or framed so no part of the face (no eyes, nose, mouth or chin) is visible; they must not resemble any real person. No logo, no brand name, no text, no watermark.

shots.prompt: A long single-breasted charcoal grey wool overcoat with notch lapels, shown on an invisible ghost mannequin, front view.
title: ウール シングル ロングコート
Charcoal Grey Wool Long Overcoat
caption: 上質なチャコールグレーのウールを使用した、クラシックなノッチドラペルのシングルブレストロングコート。洗練されたシンプルなシルエットが、落ち着きのある上品な佇まいを演出します。
A classic single-breasted long overcoat crafted from charcoal grey wool, featuring elegant notch lapels. Its clean, structured silhouette offers a sophisticated and timeless look.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of the coat's dense brushed wool fabric and a horn-style button, showing the soft fibers.
title: 密に織ったウール
Densely woven wool
caption: 起毛した厚手のウールが、風を通さず体温を逃がしません。ボタンは手に取りやすい大きめのサイズ。
Brushed, heavy wool blocks the wind and holds in warmth. The large buttons are easy to grab with cold hands.

shots.prompt: The coat worn open over a cream knit sweater and dark trousers, full-length below the chin, showing the long straight silhouette.
title: 膝が隠れるロング丈
Knee-length cut
caption: 膝まで隠れる丈で、通勤のスーツにも休日のニットにも合わせやすいまっすぐなシルエット。
A straight, knee-length line that works over a suit on weekdays and a sweater on weekends.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the coat's inside: a smooth lining and a neat inner pocket, the coat partly opened on a white surface.
title: 裏地と内ポケット
Lining and inner pocket
caption: すべりのよい裏地で、厚手のニットの上からでもすっと羽織れます。内ポケットにはスマートフォンが入ります。
A smooth lining slides easily over thick knits, and the inner pocket fits a phone.

shots.prompt: A fine-gauge merino wool crew-neck sweater in heather oatmeal beige, neatly folded flat lay seen from above.
title: メリノウール クルーネックセーター
Merino Wool Crew-Neck Sweater
caption: 細番手の糸でなめらかに編み上げた、ヘザーオートミールベージュのクルーネックセーター。丁寧に折りたたまれた平置きの佇まいから、上質なメリノウールの柔らかな質感と、シンプルで美しい仕立てが伝わります。

A fine-gauge merino wool crew-neck sweater in heather oatmeal beige, neatly folded in a flat lay from above. This classic piece showcases the smooth texture of high-quality knitwear, designed for effortless and timeless wear.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of the fine, smooth merino jersey knit stitches with a soft sheen.
title: なめらかなメリノウール
Smooth merino wool
caption: 細い糸で編んだメリノウールは、チクチクしにくく、素肌に着ても心地よい肌触り。
Fine-spun merino is soft enough to wear next to the skin, without the itch.

shots.prompt: The sweater worn tucked loosely into light grey trousers, framed from the chin to the hips.
title: 一枚でも、重ねても
On its own or layered
caption: 薄手で着ぶくれしないので、ジャケットやコートの下にも。一枚で着ても形がきれいに出ます。
Thin enough to layer under a jacket or coat without bulk, and neat enough to wear alone.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the sweater's ribbed crew neckline and ribbed cuff laid on a white surface.
title: 伸びにくいリブ
Ribs that keep their shape
caption: 首元と袖口はしっかりしたリブ編み。洗っても伸びにくく、きれいな形が続きます。
Firm rib knit at the neck and cuffs holds its shape wash after wash.

shots.prompt: A navy blue chunky cable-knit wool crew-neck sweater, shown on an invisible ghost mannequin, front view.
title: ウール ケーブルニット クルーネックセーター
Chunky Cable-Knit Wool Sweater
caption: 立体感のある美しいケーブル編みが引き立つ、ネイビーのクルーネックセーター。ゆとりのあるシルエットで、寒い季節の定番として長く寄り添う一着です。
A front view of this classic navy blue crew-neck sweater, crafted from wool with a rich, dimensional cable-knit pattern. Its relaxed silhouette makes it a timeless, comforting staple for cold days.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of the raised cable-knit pattern in thick navy wool yarn.
title: 立体的なケーブル編み
Raised cable pattern
caption: 太い糸で編んだ縄編みの柄が立体的に浮かび、着るだけで表情のある装いに。
Thick yarn makes the cables stand out, so the sweater adds texture to any outfit.

shots.prompt: The sweater worn with light blue jeans, framed from the chin to the thighs, relaxed fit.
title: ゆとりのあるシルエット
Relaxed fit
caption: 身幅にゆとりがあり、シャツの上からも重ねやすい形。デニムと合わせるだけで秋冬らしく。
Roomy through the body to layer over a shirt. Pair with denim for an easy cold-weather look.

shots.prompt: The sweater folded on a wooden chair by a window with a mug of coffee, cozy autumn morning light.
title: 寒い日の定番に
A cold-day staple
caption: 厚みのある編み地で、肌寒い朝もこれ一枚で暖か。家でも外でも頼れる一着です。
The thick knit keeps chilly mornings warm on its own, at home or out.

shots.prompt: Mid-wash blue straight-leg stretch denim jeans, laid flat, front view, full length.
title: ミッドウォッシュ ストレッチストレートデニム
Mid-Wash Straight-Leg Stretch Jeans
caption: 美しいストレートシルエットが引き立つ、ミッドウォッシュブルーのストレッチデニムです。平置きで撮影されたフロントの全体像から、シンプルで飽きのこないデザインが伝わります。
A full-length, front-facing flat lay of our mid-wash blue straight-leg stretch denim jeans, showcasing their clean silhouette and classic style.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of indigo stretch denim twill weave with fine fading and orange top-stitching.
title: よく伸びるデニム
Denim with stretch
caption: ストレッチ糸を織り込んだデニムで、しゃがんだり歩いたりしても突っ張りません。
Woven with stretch yarn, so it moves with you when you walk, sit or crouch.

shots.prompt: The jeans worn with a white t-shirt and white sneakers, framed from the waist down to the feet, straight leg.
title: まっすぐなストレート
A clean straight leg
caption: 腰から裾までまっすぐなラインで、脚をすっきり見せます。スニーカーにも革靴にも。
A straight line from hip to hem looks clean with sneakers or leather shoes.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the jeans' back pocket and belt loop with neat double stitching, plain pocket without any logo or patch.
title: 丈夫な二重のステッチ
Strong double stitching
caption: ポケットやベルト通しは二重のステッチで縫い、毎日はいてもほつれにくく仕上げています。
Double stitching on pockets and belt loops stands up to everyday wear.

shots.prompt: A dusty sage green pleated midi skirt with an elastic waistband, shown on an invisible ghost mannequin, front view.
title: 上品なダスティセージのプリーツミディスカート
Dusty Sage Green Pleated Midi Skirt
caption: 落ち着いたダスティセージグリーンが美しい、細やかなプリーツのミディ丈スカートです。ウエストは快適なゴム仕様になっており、上品さとリラックスした着心地を両立しています。
A pleated midi skirt in a calm, dusty sage green featuring a comfortable elastic waistband. This piece offers an elegant silhouette with structured pleats for a refined yet relaxed look.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the skirt's crisp, even fine pleats in a soft matte fabric.
title: くずれにくいプリーツ
Pleats that stay crisp
caption: 細かいプリーツは、たたんでも洗っても折り目が残りやすく、アイロンいらず。
The fine pleats keep their creases after folding and washing, no ironing needed.

shots.prompt: The skirt worn with a cream knit top and ankle boots, mid-stride so the pleats swing, framed from the chest down.
title: 歩くたびに揺れる
Moves as you walk
caption: 軽い生地のプリーツが、歩くたびにやわらかく揺れて、きれいな動きを見せます。
Light pleats swing softly with every step.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the skirt's soft elastic waistband from the inside, stretched slightly by the fabric itself, on a white surface.
title: 楽なウエスト
Comfortable waist
caption: 後ろがゴムのウエストで、締め付けすぎず、長い時間はいても楽です。
An elastic back waist is comfortable for long days without feeling tight.

shots.prompt: A pair of dark brown full-grain leather lace-up ankle boots, three-quarter side view.
title: 風合い豊かな本革レースアップアンクルブーツ
Classic Full-Grain Leather Lace-Up Ankle Boots
caption: 深みのあるダークブラウンのフルグレインレザーで仕立てた、クラシカルなレースアップアンクルブーツ。上質な本革の質感と端正なシルエットが際立つ、斜めからのアングルで仕上げた一枚です。

Crafted from rich, dark brown full-grain leather, these classic lace-up ankle boots are captured in a three-quarter side view. The clean perspective highlights the premium texture of the leather and their timeless silhouette.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of the boot's smooth full-grain brown leather with natural grain and a subtle polished sheen.
title: 育つ本革
Leather that ages well
caption: 表面を削らない本革は、履くほど足に馴染み、つやと深みが増していきます。
Full-grain leather softens to your foot and gains depth and shine over time.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the boot's thick rubber lug sole and welt stitching, the boot tilted to show the sole.
title: すべりにくい底
Grippy sole
caption: 溝の深いゴム底で、雨の日や落ち葉の道でもすべりにくく安心です。
A deep-lug rubber sole grips on wet streets and fallen leaves.

shots.prompt: The boots worn with cuffed dark jeans, framed from the knees down, standing on a stone pavement.
title: パンツにも合う短め丈
Ankle height for any pants
caption: くるぶしが隠れる短め丈で、デニムにもスラックスにも合わせやすい一足。
Ankle height pairs easily with jeans or tailored trousers.

shots.prompt: A pair of minimal white leather low-top sneakers with a white rubber sole, three-quarter side view.
title: ミニマルなレザースニーカー
Minimalist Leather Sneakers
caption: 上質な白レザーとシンプルなソールで仕上げた、クリーンな佇まいのローカットスニーカー。無駄のない洗練されたミニマルなデザインは、あらゆるコーディネートに優しく寄り添います。
A pair of low-top sneakers featuring clean white leather and a matching white rubber sole. Their refined, minimalist design effortlessly complements any style in your wardrobe.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the sneaker's lightweight cushioned sole cut-away feel, the shoe tilted to show the side of the sole and heel.
title: 軽くて弾むクッション
Light, springy cushioning
caption: 軽いクッション材の底で、一日歩いても足が疲れにくい履き心地です。
A lightweight cushioned sole keeps your feet comfortable all day.

shots.prompt: The sneakers worn with cropped beige chinos, framed from the knees down, walking on a light concrete floor.
title: どんな服にも
Goes with everything
caption: 飾りのない白いスニーカーは、きれいめにもカジュアルにも合う毎日の一足。
Plain white sneakers that go with smart and casual outfits alike.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of the sneaker's smooth white leather upper and neat stitching near the toe.
title: 汚れを拭けるレザー
Wipe-clean leather
caption: なめらかなレザーのアッパーは、汚れてもさっと拭くだけで白さが戻ります。
The smooth leather upper wipes clean, so it stays white.

shots.prompt: A large wool scarf in a camel and grey tartan check with fringed ends, loosely folded on a white background.
title: ウール大判タータンチェックマフラー
Large Wool Tartan Check Scarf
caption: キャメルとグレーの上品なタータンチェック柄にフリンジをあしらった、大判のウールマフラーです。白背景にふんわりと畳まれた様子が、その温かみのある柔らかな質感を伝えます。
A large wool scarf in a classic camel and grey tartan check with fringed ends, loosely folded against a clean white background to showcase its soft and warm texture.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of the scarf's soft brushed wool weave and fringe.
title: ふんわり起毛
Soft brushed finish
caption: 起毛させたウールは、ふんわり軽く、首に巻いてもチクチクしにくい肌触り。
Brushed wool feels light and soft around the neck.

shots.prompt: The scarf wrapped loosely around the neck over a navy coat, framed from the chin to the waist.
title: 大判で巻きやすい
Generous size
caption: 大判なので、ぐるぐる巻いても、肩にかけても。巻き方を変えて長く楽しめます。
Big enough to wrap twice or drape over the shoulders.

shots.prompt: The scarf neatly folded with a pair of gloves on a wooden bench outdoors, crisp winter morning light.
title: 贈り物にも
A good gift
caption: 季節を問わず使える定番の柄で、冬の贈り物にも選ばれています。
A classic check that makes an easy winter gift.

shots.prompt: A sturdy natural beige canvas tote bag with olive green leather-trim handles, standing upright, front view, plain with no print.
title: キャンバストートバッグ
Canvas Tote Bag
caption: オリーブグリーンのレザーハンドルをあしらった、ナチュラルなベージュのキャンバストートバッグです。プリントのないシンプルなデザインで、しっかりと自立する美しい佇まいが魅力です。
A sturdy, natural beige canvas tote bag featuring elegant olive green leather-trim handles. This print-free, minimalist bag stands upright on its own, showcasing its clean and structured front view.

shots.prompt: View looking into the open tote bag showing a roomy interior, an inner zip pocket and a laptop-sized document folder inside.
title: A4 が入る広さ
Fits A4 documents
caption: A4 の書類やノートパソコンも入る広さ。内ポケットで小物も迷子になりません。
Room for A4 papers or a laptop, with an inner pocket for small things.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of the thick canvas weave and the stitched join between the canvas and leather handle.
title: 丈夫な厚手キャンバス
Heavy canvas
caption: 厚手のキャンバスと、しっかり縫い付けた持ち手で、重い荷物でも安心です。
Heavy canvas and firmly stitched handles carry heavy loads.

shots.prompt: The tote carried on the shoulder with a light trench coat, framed from the chin to the hips.
title: 肩に掛けられる持ち手
Shoulder-length handles
caption: 持ち手は肩に掛けられる長さ。コートの上からでも楽に持てます。
Handles long enough to wear on the shoulder, even over a coat.

shots.prompt: A plush soft throw blanket in warm oatmeal color, neatly folded in a stack, front view.
title: ふんわりと畳まれたオーツ麦色のブランケット
Neatly Folded Oatmeal Throw Blanket
caption: 温かみのあるオーツ麦色のブランケットが、端正に折り畳まれて重なっています。見るだけで伝わるふっくらと柔らかな質感が、お部屋に優しいぬくもりを添えます。
A plush, soft throw blanket in a warm oatmeal color, beautifully folded and stacked. The front view highlights its incredibly gentle texture and comforting weight.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of the blanket's dense, fluffy plush pile.
title: ふわふわの手触り
Plush and soft
caption: 毛足のある、ふわふわの生地で、触れた瞬間から暖かさを感じられます。
A dense, fluffy pile that feels warm the moment you touch it.

shots.prompt: The blanket draped over the arm of a light grey sofa in a calm living room, warm evening lamp light.
title: ソファでも、ひざ掛けにも
For the sofa or your lap
caption: ソファに掛けても、ひざ掛けにしても。部屋になじむやさしい色です。
Drape it over the sofa or across your lap. A soft color that suits any room.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the blanket's neatly finished, stitched edge, folded corner on a white surface.
title: 洗っても長持ち
Made to last
caption: 端はていねいに始末してあり、家で洗ってもほつれにくく長く使えます。
Neatly finished edges hold up to washing at home.
